caseNameFull: Swiss National Insurance Co., Ltd. v. Crowley, Alien Property Custodian
attorneys: Messrs. Frederic B. Cou-dert and Alexis C. Coudert for petitioner. Solicitor General Fahy, Assistant Attorney General Cox, and Messrs. George A. McNulty, Harry Leroy Jones, Robert L. Stern, and Frederick L. Smith for respondents.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia denied.

The Chief Justice, Mr. Justice Murphy, and Mr. Justice Jackson took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
